Quickly Impute Missing Data

Source: R/quick_impute.R
quick_impute.Rd

Automatically imputes missing values in a dataset. Numeric columns are imputed using the median, and categorical columns are imputed using the mode.

Usage

quick_impute(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame containing missing values.

Value

A clean data frame with no missing values.

Examples

messy_df <- data.frame(
  age = c(25, NA, 30, 22),
  city = c("NY", "LA", NA, "NY")
)
clean_df <- quick_impute(messy_df)
#> All missing values have been successfully imputed!
